description: Read back what happened in the trader's last replay of one market: every beat on the tape, each of their strategies' trades and state changes, and their own moves (travel, speed, seek), in order with their times, plus the recording's hash (the same at any replay speed). Use it after replay_open, or when the trader asks what they just watched, to answer from what was recorded rather than from memory.

kinds.description: only these sources or kinds (default: all)

name: replay_record
